headline: Ways to work together

offers.title: Retained Advisory
offers.body: A sustained advisory relationship starting at 6 months, working with both the strategic decisions and the person making them. You.

offers.title: Deep day
offers.body: A single day, focused entirely on you. You leave with clarity on what is next for you and a navigation toolkit to reach your best thinking and action, even in rough seas.

offers.title: Retreats in the Rheintal
offers.body: Small group retreats are held a few times each year, in the Alpstein region, for founders and executives.

closing: For pricing and engagement details, please get in touch.
